narrative:
Cost of sales is GBP 307.7M in the Q3 forecast — 46.3% of revenue — so gross margin is 53.7% against 54.1% in the budget.

• Wholesale access (Openreach, CityFibre, altnets) 36% — rentals rise with the Openreach CPI+3.9% price changes
• Interconnect & call termination 24%, platform licences 12%, MVNO wholesale 10%, hardware & CPE 10%, network direct 8%

Gamma Business gross margin falls from 55.6% to about 54.3% as high-margin legacy voice (72% GM) is replaced by cloud voice at 48–58%. YTD, legacy decline removed GBP 9.8M of GP and PhoneLine+ replaced GBP 6.1M — a 62% replacement ratio.

signals.title: Openreach wholesale price changes (CPI+3.9%)
signals.excerpt: Wholesale rental increases flow into Gamma's cost of sales; in 2026 partner price-list changes lagged by two months (about £0.3M GP).

signals.title: UK PSTN switch-off — January 2027
signals.excerpt: Exchanges moving to stop-sell accelerate legacy ISDN/PSTN ceases; customers must migrate to IP voice (PhoneLine+, Horizon, SIP) or leave.

signals.title: FY2025 results: revenue £645.8m, adjusted EBITDA £141.7m
signals.excerpt: Gross profit £348.2m (54%), recurring revenue £572.0m. Germany gross profit +197% to £78.4m; Gamma Business GP −2%; Enterprise GP flat.
